tool.name: mash triangle
tool.command:
#import re #set $input_files = [] #for $input in $inputs #set $safe_name = re.sub(r'[^\w\-_\.]', '_', $input.element_identifier) + '.' + $input.ext ln -s '$input' '$safe_name' && $input_files.append(str($safe_name)) #end for #set $file_list = ' '.join(["'%s'" % $f for $f in $input_files])
mash triangle -p \${GALAXY_SLOTS:-1} #if $output.out.edge_list: -E -v${max_p_value} -d$(max_distance) #end if #if $output.comment_fields: -C #end if $file_list > '$output'

param.name: inputs
param.label: Input sequences
param.help: A dataset collection of fasta, fastq (gzipped or not), or Mash sketch files (.msh) with matching k-mer sizes.

param.name: format
param.label: Specify the output format
param.help: Output format for distances. PHYLIP matrix is the default. For edge list, output fields will be [seq1, seq2, dist, p-val, shared-hashes].

param.name: max_p_value
param.label: Maximum p-value
param.help: Maximum p-value to report in edge list.

param.name: max_distance
param.label: Maximum distance
param.help: Maximum distance to report in edge list.

param.name: comment_fields
param.label: Use comment fields for sequence names instead of IDs.
